Show me the evidence for the Bill with a lapsed event and a later recorded stage. What can and cannot be concluded?

The records show more than one such case. For Protection of Private Residences (Against Targeted Picketing) Bill 2021, they record a Bill Lapsed Event and a Second Stage on 8 November 2024, then another Second Stage on 1 May 2025. For Seanad Electoral (University Members) (Amendment) Bill 2020, they record a Bill Lapsed Event and a Committee Stage on 29 January 2025, then another Committee Stage on 27 March 2025. These entries establish that the events are recorded with those dates. They do not explain the apparent inconsistencies, establish what procedural effect the entries had, or certify either Bill’s final outcome. If you meant a different Bill, please give its title.
